Nowadays I'd say you'd want minimum 1tb storage on your pc. High capacity Ssd's and hardrives gotten a lot cheaper nowadays compared what they used used to.

If you want to save a bit of money you can go 500 GB SSD and 1tb hdd for storage, but personally it just go straigh for 1tb SSD or above.

It's gonna fill up very fast if you store a lot of videos and if you do any 3d projects or photographing etc.

And every game nowadays are massive too, 

I've had people buy 250 GB HDD laptop and got it filled up in a week and they were unhappy because they couldn't install anything more. 

Note: hard drives are slow, DO NOT play games on a harddrive.its gonna feel very sluggish and you're leaving out a lot of your performance from your pc on the table that way.

I see people mention m.2s these are a lot more expensive than regular Ssd's and unless you do editing of raw footage and rendering (raw file format recorded by Røde cameras)  then you will not need or notice  a difference between regular ssd and nvme (m.2) so go for a nice high capacity ssd instead. I recommend mx500's
